div.p: Dear ,

Congratulations on accepting our offer of employment! Please upload the six (6) mandatory documents below to finalize your personnel file and employee registration. Alternatively, you may also simply reply to your Document Request email with these files attached.

div.label: 1. Picture (Passport Size) *
div.p: Recent color photograph with white or light blue background (for profile & ID card).

div.label: 2. CNIC Copy *
div.p: Clear scanned copy of National Identity Card (both front and back).

div.label: 3. Resignation Acceptance Letter *
div.p: Acceptance letter / clearance from existing or previous company.

div.label: 4. Educational Documents *
div.p: Degrees, mark sheets, and transcripts (combine into one PDF or archive).

div.label: 5. Certification Documents (If applicable)
div.p: Professional certifications (PEC, Cisco, Microsoft, PMP, AWS, etc.).

div.label: 6. Professional Documents *
div.p: Experience letters, previous appointment letters, and recent payslips.
